en_title: Rep. Ritchie Torres Introduces Legislation to Ensure Gamers Own Their Digital Games
cn_title: 美国议员提案保障数字游戏所有权
subtitle: 买游戏，不是租游戏
opus_summary: 美国众议员Torres提出法案，拟保障玩家对已购数字游戏的所有权，而非仅获得可撤销的许可。法案还要求在线游戏支持离线游玩，停服后仍可玩，能否通过尚待观察。

paragraphs.en: Democratic Congressman Ritchie Torres is introducing legislation that aims to ensure you own your digital games, rather than merely buying a license that gives you permission to play them.
paragraphs.cn: 美国民主党众议员Ritchie Torres提出法案，旨在确保玩家拥有自己购买的数字游戏，而不是仅仅买到允许游玩的许可。

paragraphs.en: The bill, known as The Power to the Players Act, would direct the Fedral Trade Commission (FTC) to establish regulations that would protect gamers and their digital libraries. In short, Torres wants to ensure that when you buy a digital game, you actually own it, as opposed to getting a license that can be revoked. Additionally, the bill would require online games to have offline functionality, so that when servers are shut down, the content can still be played by those who own the game.
paragraphs.cn: 这项名为《赋权玩家法案》（The Power to the Players Act）的提案，将要求美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）制定规定，保护玩家及其数字游戏库。简而言之，Torres希望确保玩家购买数字游戏后真正拥有它，而不是获得一份随时可能被撤销的许可。此外，法案还将要求在线游戏提供离线功能，让拥有游戏的玩家在服务器关闭后仍能游玩其中的内容。

paragraphs.en: “Consumers must have the right to own, the right to play, and the right to transfer the games they buy,” Torres said in a press release . “A game that can be taken away the moment a company pulls the plug is not a purchase. It is a rental disguised as a sale. Families in the Bronx and across the country save up to buy these games, and they deserve better than a license that can vanish at any time. The Power To The Players Act ensures consumers own what they buy and can keep playing long after a company moves on.”
paragraphs.cn: Torres在新闻稿中表示：「消费者必须有权拥有、游玩和转让自己购买的游戏。如果一家公司一停服，游戏就能被收走，那就不是买游戏，而是打着销售幌子的租赁。布朗克斯区乃至全美各地的家庭攒钱购买这些游戏，他们应得的不该只是一份随时可能消失的许可。《赋权玩家法案》将确保消费者拥有自己购买的游戏，即便公司早已不再支持游戏，他们也能继续游玩。」

paragraphs.en: Torres made an example out of NBA 2K25, a game that recently announced that it would be rendering single-player modes inaccessible due to servers shutting down. The news gained widespread attention, as many were confused why a game that's only two years old was becoming obsolete so soon.
paragraphs.cn: Torres以《NBA 2K25》为例。该作近日宣布，服务器关闭后，单人模式也将无法游玩。这一消息引发广泛关注，许多人不解：一款才推出两年的游戏，为何这么快就要无法使用了。

paragraphs.en: Torres' bill addresses ongoing controversies in the industry. Earlier this year, it was confirmed that PlayStation would be ditching physical games starting in 2028 , which would mean gamers wouldn't be able to truly own their games starting with the next-generation. GTA 6 is also skipping a physical release this November , meaning there won't be any used copies of the game following its release. It's a slippery slope, and one that gamers have been battling for some time now.
paragraphs.cn: Torres的法案针对的是游戏行业持续存在的争议。今年早些时候，PlayStation已确认将从2028年起放弃实体游戏，也就是说，从下一世代开始，玩家将无法真正拥有自己的游戏。《GTA6》今年11月发售时也不会推出实体版，因此发售后也不会有二手游戏可买。这是一个不断滑向更糟局面的趋势，而玩家与之抗争已有一段时间。

paragraphs.en: The Stop Killing Games movement has been fighting to make games more accessible to their current owners, even after they shut down servers. Torress' bill would ensure they get their way, at least in the United States. Of course, we'll have to see if this bill makes it to the finish line, but it's a noble effort and shows that someone is trying to make change happen.
paragraphs.cn: Stop Killing Games运动一直在争取让已经拥有游戏的玩家更容易继续游玩，即使游戏服务器已经关闭。Torres的法案将确保这一诉求得以实现，至少在美国如此。当然，这项法案最终能否通过，还要拭目以待。但这番努力值得肯定，也表明有人正在尝试推动改变。
